id: \bWhere did I put that book?
en: \bWhere did I put that book?
it: \bDove ho messo quel libro?

id: This ball holds a Piplup. Would you like to take it?
en: This ball holds a Piplup. Would you like to take it?
it: Questa Ball contiene un Piplup. Vuoi prenderlo?

id: \bRowan: Nice to meet you. So I'm guessing the Trainer that was in the way was Dawn. She's a new Trainer so she may cause some trouble.
en: \bRowan: Nice to meet you. So I'm guessing the Trainer that was in the way was Dawn. She's a new Trainer so she may cause some trouble.
it: \bRowan: Piacere di conoscerti. Immagino che l'Allenatrice che ti bloccava la strada fosse Lucinda. È alle prime armi, quindi potrebbe combinare qualche guaio.

id: \bYou came from Kanto, if I recall. Professor Oak informed me that you would be coming.
en: \bYou came from Kanto, if I recall. Professor Oak informed me that you would be coming.
it: \bVieni da Kanto, se ricordo bene. Il Professor Oak mi aveva avvisato del tuo arrivo.

id: \bOn the table beside me I have a Piplup for you. It's nothing special, so don't feel any pressure to take it.
en: \bOn the table beside me I have a Piplup for you. It's nothing special, so don't feel any pressure to take it.
it: \bSul tavolo accanto a me c'è un Piplup per te. Non ha niente di speciale, quindi non sentirti obbligato a prenderlo.

id: \bRowan: I have a Piplup here for you.
en: \bRowan: I have a Piplup here for you.
it: \bRowan: Ho qui un Piplup per te.

id: \bAlso feel free to heal your Pokémon at my machine.
en: \bAlso feel free to heal your Pokémon at my machine.
it: \bInoltre, sentiti libero di curare i tuoi Pokémon con la mia macchina.

id: \bRowan: Pokémon are turning back into Eggs. Gates have also been opening across the region. I believe those lead to other worlds.
en: \bRowan: Pokémon are turning back into Eggs. Gates have also been opening across the region. I believe those lead to other worlds.
it: \bRowan: I Pokémon stanno tornando a essere Uova. Inoltre si stanno aprendo dei varchi in tutta la regione. Credo che conducano ad altri mondi.

id: \bDialga and Palkia are likely behind this. The bigger question is why.
en: \bDialga and Palkia are likely behind this. The bigger question is why.
it: \bProbabilmente dietro a tutto questo ci sono Dialga e Palkia. La vera domanda è perché.

id: \bRowan: If you wish I have a Piplup here for you. Nothing special about it though.
en: \bRowan: If you wish I have a Piplup here for you.  Nothing special about it though.
it: \bRowan: Se vuoi, ho qui un Piplup per te. Anche se non ha niente di speciale.

id: \bPaul: Thank you for healing my Pokémon, Professor. I'll be on my way then.
en: \bPaul: Thank you for healing my Pokémon, Professor. I'll be on my way then.
it: \bPaul: Grazie per aver curato i miei Pokémon, Professore. Allora me ne vado.

id: \bWhat is it? A Trainer is blocking your path and you were hoping the Professor could help you?
en: \bWhat is it? A Trainer is blocking your path and you were hoping the Professor could help you?
it: \bChe c'è? Un Allenatore ti blocca la strada e speravi che il Professore potesse aiutarti?

id: \bPathetic. Just push them aside and move on.
en: \bPathetic. Just push them aside and move on.
it: \bPatetico. Spingilo di lato e vai avanti.

id: \bOh do my words upset you? Why don't we have a battle then? Beating someone like you may just make my day.
en: \bOh do my words upset you? Why don't we have a battle then? Beating someone like you may just make my day.
it: \bOh, le mie parole ti offendono? Allora perché non lottiamo? Battere uno come te potrebbe anche migliorarmi la giornata.

id: \bPaul: You weren't as good as I hoped. Step aside.
en: \bPaul: You weren't as good as I hoped. Step aside.
it: \bPaul: Non eri bravo quanto speravo. Fatti da parte.

id: Your Pokémon were fully healed.
en: Your Pokémon were fully healed.
it: I tuoi Pokémon sono stati curati completamente.

id: \bProfessor Rowan does more than just give out Pokémon.
en: \bProfessor Rowan does more than just give out Pokémon.
it: \bIl Professor Rowan non si limita a distribuire Pokémon.

id: \bHe figures out how and why Pokémon evolve.
en: \bHe figures out how and why Pokémon evolve.
it: \bStudia come e perché i Pokémon si evolvono.
